items.title: Wilbur and Orville Wright: The First Airplane

lines.en: Soon, they needed a place to test their ideas about flight.
lines.ko: 곧, 그들은 비행에 대한 생각을 시험해 볼 장소가 필요했다.
lines.stress: SOON, they NEEDed a PLACE to TEST their iDEas about FLIGHT.
lines.chunks: Soon, they needed a place / to test their ideas about flight.

lines.en: The best place with the best wind conditions seemed to be a piece of sandy land in North Carolina along the coast of the Atlantic Ocean.
lines.ko: 가장 좋은 바람 조건을 가진 최적의 장소는 대서양 연안, 노스캐롤라이나의 모래땅인 것 같았다.
lines.stress: The BEST PLACE with the BEST WIND conDItions SEEMED to be a PIECE of SANdy LAND in north caroLIna along the COAST of the atLANtic OCean.
lines.chunks: The best place with the best wind conditions / seemed to be a piece of sandy land / in North Carolina along the coast of the Atlantic Ocean.

lines.en: It was called Kill Devil Hill, near the town of Kitty Hawk.
lines.ko: 그곳은 키티호크 마을 근처의 킬 데빌 힐이라고 불렸다.
lines.stress: It was CALLED KILL DEVil HILL, near the TOWN of KITty HAWK.
lines.chunks: It was called Kill Devil Hill, / near the town of Kitty Hawk.

lines.en: The Wright brothers did many tests with gliders at Kitty Hawk.
lines.ko: 라이트 형제는 키티호크에서 글라이더로 많은 실험을 했다.
lines.stress: The WRIGHT BROthers DID MAny TESTS with GLIders at KITty HAWK.
lines.chunks: The Wright brothers did many tests / with gliders at Kitty Hawk.

lines.en: With these tests, they learned how to solve many problems.
lines.ko: 이 실험들을 통해 그들은 많은 문제를 해결하는 방법을 배웠다.
lines.stress: With these TESTS, they LEARNed how to SOLVE MAny PROBlems.
lines.chunks: With these tests, / they learned how to solve many problems.

lines.en: By the autumn of 1903, Wilbur and Orville had designed and built an airplane powered by a gasoline engine.
lines.ko: 1903년 가을 무렵, 윌버와 오빌은 가솔린 엔진으로 움직이는 비행기를 설계하고 제작했다.
lines.stress: By the AUtumn of 1903, WILbur and ORville had deSIGNed and BUILT an AIRplane POWered by a GASoline ENgine.
lines.chunks: By the autumn of 1903, / Wilbur and Orville had designed and built / an airplane powered by a gasoline engine.

lines.en: The plane had wings 12 meters across.
lines.ko: 그 비행기는 날개폭이 12미터였다.
lines.stress: The PLANE HAD WINGS 12 MEters aCROSS.
lines.chunks: The plane had wings / 12 meters across.

lines.en: It weighed about 340 kilograms, including the pilot.
lines.ko: 그것은 조종사를 포함해 무게가 약 340킬로그램이었다.
lines.stress: It WEIGHED about 340 KIlograms, inCLUDing the PIlot.
